intro: The New Orleans band of Alynda Segarra.
story: Alynda Segarra left the Puerto Rican Bronx at 17, traveled by freight train and settled in New Orleans, where she formed Hurray for the Riff Raff. Small Town Heroes, on ATO in 2014, widened the audience, and the Irish Times called it irresistible. They played Pickathon in 2016. The Navigator, produced by Paul Butler, came in March 2017, and NPR heard roots music turned against nostalgia. Life on Earth followed in 2022 and The Past Is Still Alive in 2024, and in 2026 Live Forever, a first live album, came out on Nonesuch.
artist_reel_line: Live Forever, their first live album, came out on Nonesuch in 2026.

story: Open Mike Eagle is a Chicago-raised, Los Angeles-based rapper who makes what he calls art rap for Mello Music Group. Hella Personal Film Festival, made in London with the British producer Paul White and released March 25, 2016, was the new record when he played Pickathon that year. Brick Body Kids Still Daydream followed in September 2017 and Anime, Trauma and Divorce in 2020. Neighborhood Gods Unlimited, in July 2025, won year-end acclaim, and Doomed! came in 2026.
artist_reel_line: Neighborhood Gods Unlimited won year-end acclaim in 2025, and Doomed! followed.

story: Palehound is the project of Ellen Kempner, who drew attention with the 2013 single Pet Carrot and released the debut Dry Food in 2015. The band played Pickathon in 2016. A Place I'll Always Go came out June 16, 2017 on Polyvinyl, NPR streamed it as a First Listen, and Kempner has said it is about loss and learning to grow past the pain. Black Friday followed in 2019 and Eye on the Bat in 2023, and in November 2026 Kempner played Brooklyn alongside Julia Jacklin.
artist_reel_line: A Brooklyn show with Julia Jacklin came in November 2026.

story: Ty Segall wrote the double album Manipulator over about fourteen months and released it on Drag City on August 25, 2014, and Ty Rex, a covers album of T. Rex songs, followed in 2015. He played Pickathon in 2013, 2015, 2016 and 2017, and in 2016 he came with The Muggers. Freedom's Goblin, with his Freedom Band, came out January 26, 2018, then First Taste in 2019, Possession in 2025 and Chrome in 2026, with the companion EP Love Fuzzz.
artist_reel_line: Chrome and the EP Love Fuzzz came in 2026, with a South American tour.

story: Daniel Norgren was born in Borås, Sweden, in 1983 and has worked with the small Superpuma Records label since 2006; his father introduced him to American music. Buck, in March 2013, and Alabursy, in June 2015, were both recorded mostly at home on a four-track cassette studio. He played Pickathon in 2016 and again in 2018. Wooh Dang, in 2019, was recorded live and all-analog in a nineteenth-century Swedish farmhouse and was his first album with wide international release. Songs from Alabursy turned up in the 2022 film The Eight Mountains, and he has road-tested new songs on summer tours of Sweden, Norway, Belgium and the Netherlands.
artist_reel_line: He has road-tested new songs in Sweden, Norway, Belgium and the Netherlands.

intro: A Los Angeles composer and songwriter.
story: Julia Holter, a Los Angeles composer and songwriter, signed to Domino in 2013 after Ekstasis in 2012. Have You in My Wilderness, her fourth album, came out September 25, 2015, a turn toward intimate ballads that NPR ran as a First Listen and that Mojo and Uncut both named album of the year. She played Pickathon in 2016. The double album Aviary followed October 26, 2018, a return to her more abstract side; she has said she was digging into her subconscious, where Wilderness had worked in a specific tradition. A 2024 album on Domino followed, and Materia in 2026.
artist_reel_line: Materia came out on Domino in 2026.

act: Thao & The Get Down Stay Down
intro: A San Francisco band led by Thao Nguyen.
story: Thao & The Get Down Stay Down dates to 2003 in San Francisco, when Thao Nguyen met the drummer Willis Thompson. A Man Alive, the fourth album, came out March 4, 2016 on Ribbon Music, produced by Merrill Garbus of tUnE-yArDs, and NPR ran it as a First Listen. The band had played Pickathon in 2009 and 2011 before returning in 2016. Temple followed May 15, 2020 on Ribbon Music, and the band called it quits in 2021, eighteen years after Nguyen met Thompson. Nguyen has since returned to Kill Rock Stars with the first new music in six years and toured with Lord Huron.
artist_reel_line: Thao Nguyen returned to Kill Rock Stars and toured with Lord Huron.

story: The Deslondes formed in the Holy Cross neighborhood of New Orleans's Lower Ninth Ward, named for a street there; Sam Doores quit school after reading Woody Guthrie's autobiography and moved to the city. Doores and the bassist Dan Cutler had played in Hurray for the Riff Raff. After interest from several labels at SXSW 2013, the self-titled debut came out June 9, 2015 on New West, and NPR heard country that never left Guthrie's populist folk or rock and roll. They played Pickathon in 2016. Doores released a solo album on New West in March 2020, Roll It Out came in 2024, and Don't Let It Die in May 2026.
artist_reel_line: Don't Let It Die came out in May 2026, and they played Hardly Strictly Bluegrass.
